The current IPNA selector is an official online visa-application dataset, but it contains no Israel or Kosovo entry; the MFA announcement and portal terms do not supply a nationality-specific visitor rule for either. Absence is not converted into visa-required, visa-free, eVisa, visa-on-arrival, prior-security-approval, document-recognition, or entry-prohibition treatment. Any prohibition is also outside the present taxonomy.

The current IPNA selector is a foreigner-visa workflow and nevertheless lists Yemen as an application nationality. Neither it, the MFA eVisa announcement, nor the portal’s Visit Visa terms establishes a Yemeni ordinary-passport holder’s citizenship or entry treatment. Citizenship is not inferred from the destination code, and no nationality-specific controlling source opened in this review resolves the row.
